LESSON: LISTENING FOR GIST: ATTENTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.6: Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: what is your father’s name?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify members of the family
2. respond to oral questions from a text on naming members of the nuclear family
3. appreciate the roles of immediate family members

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: LISTENING FOR GIST: ATTENTIVE LISTENING
This lesson teaches Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening for Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify members of the family
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. respond to oral questions from a text on naming members of the nuclear family
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the roles of immediate family members
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening above.
2. Explain Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what is your father’s name?
2. Why should we pronounce words correctly?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify members of the family
2. respond to oral questions from a text on naming members of the nuclear family
3. appreciate the roles of immediate family members

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
